name: Model
h1: Single point of access: accel | torque | series | partials | budget

name: Options
h1: Validated option set with fidelity presets

name: const
h1: Constants owned by the toolbox

name: toolboxVersion
h1: Semantic version (single authority)

name: dependencyReport
h1: Presence and version of the ecosystem toolboxes

name: fail
h1: Uniform error raising with identifier taxonomy and correction hints

name: provenance
h1: Metadata record that travels with every result

name: buildMex
h1: Build the MEX gateways in mex/ (msis kernel; never committed) or report their state

name: readACC1B
h1: ACC1B/ACT1B/ACH1B reader over gracefoReading (3xK SRF accelerations + aux)

name: readSCA1B
h1: SCA1B reader: ICRF->SRF quaternions conjugated once to BODY->GCRS

name: readGNV1B
h1: GNV1B reader: ITRS state rotated to GCRS via referenceSystem

name: readTHR1B
h1: THR1B thruster event reader (impulse priors for qc)

name: readMAS1B
h1: MAS1B tank-mass reader (NOT spacecraft mass)

name: readMAG1B
h1: MAG1B reader: measured field (SI) and magnetorquer branch and net currents

name: massModel
h1: Spacecraft mass model: handbook constant or MAS1B-driven variable mass

name: spaceWeather
h1: Space-weather provider with query(epoch): F10.7 F30 S/M/Y10.7 Ap Kp Dst

name: importCERES
h1: CERES EBAF TOA monthly fluxes (obs4MIPs netCDF) as lat x lon x month grids

name: importGroopsGrid
h1: GROOPS binary gridded data: a global grid with solid angles and values (CERES albedo and longwave)

name: igrfCoefficients
h1: IGRF-14 coefficient loader with the model's own interpolation and SV rule

name: readSwarmDensity
h1: Swarm POD-only thermosphere density (ESA SW_OPER_DNSxPOD_2_) from VirES HAPI CSV

name: readIMU1B
h1: IMU1B reader: each gyro's filtered accumulated angle (rad) per record

name: density
h1: Thermosphere density and composition (exponential msis00 msis21 dtm2020)

name: densityScale
h1: Observed daily scale on a model density from Swarm POD-only densities

name: densityDriverScale
h1: Daily scale on NRLMSISE-00 predicted from F30 and Ap for any date

name: wind
h1: Relative-velocity builder: co-rotation from referenceSystem plus HWM14 or a given wind field

name: eclipseFactor
h1: Shadow function nu from 0 to 1: cylindrical conical solaarsCF plus lunar

name: earthRadiance
h1: Earth albedo and longwave emission on cap tiles (pointSource knocke ceres)

name: magneticField
h1: IGRF main geomagnetic field at Earth-fixed positions (tesla; any frame)

name: radiationSources
h1: Source list {dir_body P band} from Sun and Earth radiance for one epoch batch

name: MacroModel
h1: Panel geometry frozen and validated once

name: graceFO
h1: GRACE-FO macro model from JPL D-56935

name: grace
h1: GRACE-A/B macro model from the GRACE Product Specification (Bettadpur 2012)

name: boxWing
h1: Generic box-wing macro model factory

name: selfShadow
h1: Per-panel unobstructed fraction toward a direction: exact ray cast or cube-map table

name: flowShadow
h1: Self-shadowing of a free-molecular gas stream: flux-weighted occlusion ratios per species

name: thermalState
h1: Per-panel temperatures: steady state or transient (Wöske)

name: AttitudeProvider
h1: BODY->GCRS quaternions at query epochs (SCA1B or nominal) via referenceSystem.interpolateQuaternions

name: checkAttitudeSense
h1: Physics test of quaternion sense (nadir and line-of-sight)

name: attitudeQuality
h1: Attitude-quality diagnostic: SCA1B rates against the IMU gyros and the nominal frame with 1 and 2 cpr

name: gsiCoefficients
h1: Normal and tangential plate coefficients: sentman maxwell constantCd (cll/schamberg refuse)

name: accommodation
h1: Energy accommodation per epoch: fixed or Pilinski 2010 or the Walker/Mehta adsorbate mixture

name: dragPanelForce
h1: Per-panel gas-momentum force in body frame

name: radiationPanelForce
h1: Per-panel radiation force for a source list in body frame

name: thermalRecoil
h1: Per-panel thermal re-emission recoil force

name: assemble
h1: Reductions: F = sum F_k and tau = sum (r_k - r_cm) x F_k

name: bodyTorques
h1: Gravity-gradient and magnetic body torques

name: partials
h1: Analytic per-panel derivatives: alpha densityScale speed pressureScale temperature

name: singleEpoch
h1: Compiled single-epoch kernel: gas radiation and thermal recoil with their reductions

name: Sensor
h1: Abstract measurement model: observe / partials / noiseModel

name: Electrostatic
h1: Electrostatic accelerometer: bias scale matrix proof-mass offset coupling; L1B CRN filter by default

name: AtomInterferometer
h1: Cold-atom interferometer: phase = k_eff a T^2 with dead time rotation and the 2 pi ambiguity

name: DragFree
h1: Drag-free residual: sensitivity high-pass cascade with actuator saturation

name: calibrate
h1: Accelerometer calibration of an Arc against a Model or a reference Arc: timeSeriesPreparation.run then lsqvce.fit; attribution

name: DynamicsSource
h1: The acceleration as gjToolbox's integrator interface (native C entry)

name: forceBudget
h1: Per-effect per-axis acceleration budget over an arc; chunked and across models

name: densityInversion
h1: Thermosphere density from calibrated accelerations; the inversion is a division

name: syntheticPair
h1: Truth generator: a 10 Hz model arc and its CRN-filtered 1 Hz observation with every planted value

name: Calibration
h1: An accelerometer calibration: scale + time-varying bias + uncertainty + gates; apply/invert/save/load

name: fitCalibration
h1: The calibration estimator: CRN-filtered bias basis and model columns per axis through lsqvce.fit; VIF gate + bootstrap + EIV bound

name: compareCalibrations
h1: Rank candidate calibration models per axis by blocked cross-validation (timeSeriesPreparation.crossval); AIC/BIC reported as IC_unreliable

name: perRevolution
h1: Accelerometer bias and diagonal scale per orbital revolution through fitCalibration; a gated window is NaN with its reason

name: attributeRevolutions
h1: Per-revolution scales regressed on drivers (beta prime + eclipse + space weather + effects + time) via regressDrivers; verdict density | geometry | sensor | mixed | unresolved

name: plotCalibration
h1: Figure of a calibration: scale and bias with their bands and the residual ACF before and after whitening

name: plotAttribution
h1: Figure of the attribution: per-revolution scales over time and against their strongest drivers; verdict banner
